Maya (PulseCart): Hi team — PulseCart needs to onboard a transaction-aware rewriter + reranker for post-purchase summaries. Must be private (VPC) and compliant with our retail PHI clause. We have a renewal conversation in 5 weeks; can we get a canary + eval plan before that?
Ravi (CS): Hey Maya — noted. Quick q: expected peak qps, target p95, and do you require embedding residency in your VPC? Also retention policy for logs?
Maya (PulseCart): Peak ~12 qps, p95 target 350ms, embeddings must stay in our VPC. Logs retained 12 months. Canary ideally within 3 weeks.
Noah (SE): Private deployment ok. Need VPC peering, KMS key share, and a service account for model pulls. For 12 qps with <350ms p95 we recommend 2x A10g GPUs (3-node pool for headroom).
Ana (ML): Eval plan: retrieval metrics (MRR@10), rerank NDCG@3, and summarization ROUGE-L + extraction-based PHI leakage test (precision/recall of leaked tokens). I'll sketch harness.
Priya (Security): Requirements: signed DPA, key rotation policy, KMS audit logs to SIEM, and penetration test pre-rollout. Also need red-team prompt set focused on invoice/receipt PII.
Ravi (CS): Renewal note: finance flagged this account as "at-risk" if we don't show performance and compliance before renewal. So canary timing is critical.
Noah (SE): Proposed rollout policy snippet: 
```json
{"route":"pulsecart-summaries","policy":{"stages":[{"pct":5,"duration":"24h"},{"pct":30,"duration":"72h"}],"fallback":"small-rerank-6b","latency_slo_ms":350}}
```
Ana (ML): For dataset, request: 1k queries + gold summaries, 500 adversarial prompts for PHI leakage, and a dev set for latency p95. I can run evals if PulseCart shares dataset location and access.
Maya (PulseCart): We'll provide dataset + S3 location and ARN for the KMS key by EOD Friday. We'll also share red-team examples.
Priya (Security): Also confirm: no raw PHI to any hosted third-party models, embeddings encrypted-at-rest, HSM optional but preferred.
Noah (SE): Infra checklist: VPC peering, NAT rules for outbound model pulls, least-privilege IAM, and a deployment window for a rolling canary. Ops will need a maintenance window.
Ravi (CS): I'll set up a technical kickoff and tag finance/renewals. Can you confirm the hard stop date for your renewal?
Maya (PulseCart): Renewal is 2026-06-01. We need sign-off on canary by 2026-05-25 to feel confident.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "PulseCart onboarding kickoff" on 2026-05-02 14:00 UTC (calendar invites sent).
Ana (ML): I'll push an eval repo stub: https://git.redwood.ai/pulsecart/onboard-evals and include eval scripts + metrics template.
Priya (Security): If the canary finds any PHI leakage above 0.01% token recall on adversarial prompts, we stop and open an incident.
Noah (SE): Cost forecast note: 2x A10g baseline + storage + networking. Ravi, want me to send an estimate to PulseCart finance?
Ravi (CS): Yes please. I'll loop in @finance and attach a cost template.
Maya (PulseCart): Thanks everyone. We'll upload dataset + key ARN by Friday and join the kickoff.
Ravi (CS): Wrap-up: Noah/Ana to own eval + infra prep, Priya to sign security checklist, Maya to deliver artifacts, Ravi to coordinate kickoff and renewal escalation.
